records.text: I inspected the attached original scan pixels for PDF pp. 900–901, including the headword, the star passage, and the continuation. PDF p. 900 visibly prints 《合集》11503:“有新大星并火。” followed by “可能指的是火星”; the printed graph in “大星” is 晶, with the book glossing it as 星. The wording matches the provisional OCR; I found no literal OCR error in this passage. The entry continues on p. 901 with the graph-history discussion and ends before the next headword 燹. This scan confirms what the book says, not that its celestial identification is correct.
